name: Twilight Giant
intro: The Twilight Giant pathway is the archetype of overwhelming physical strength, defense and combat authority. Its later sequences become terrifying engines of destruction.

meter.name: Resolve
meter.full: Protect an ally and counter a direct attack
meter.quirkText: Combat-only weapon mastery and physical durability.

ability.name: Heavy Cleave
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Heavy Cleave — Deals 145% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Physical damage (22% base DEF bypass); +15% DEF bypass on this cast; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 15 SP · Cooldown 1 turn.

ability.name: Dawn Shield
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Dawn Shield — Grants a 20% Max HP shield; lasts until depleted or dispelled; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 25 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Light of Dawn
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Light of Dawn — Deals 160% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Elemental damage (22% base DEF bypass); resistance uses the average of Fire, Water, Lightning and Frost; Removes Burn, Bleed, Poison, Curse, Curse link, Silenced, Confused, Sleep, Stunned, Frozen, Freeze, Bound; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 35 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Guardian Stance
ability.label: Active Stance
ability.description: Guardian Stance — +30% DEF for 2 turns; Reduces incoming all damage by 20% until your next turn after shields; Redirects enemy target selection to you for 2 turns, unless taunt-immune; At 100 charge, protect allies with 20% Max HP shields and ready one retaliatory strike for 2 turns.; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 45 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Dawn Guardian Barrier
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Dawn Guardian Barrier — +25% DEF for 2 turns; Grants a 20% Max HP shield; lasts until depleted or dispelled; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 50 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Giant's Might
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Giant's Might — +20% Max HP; +20% Physical direct-damage resistance. Passive.

ability.name: Sword of Twilight
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Sword of Twilight — Deals 270% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Decay damage (22% base DEF bypass); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 85 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Twilight Decay
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Twilight Decay — Deals 330% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Decay damage (22% base DEF bypass); Enemy DEF −30% for 2 turns; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 100 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Twilight Colossus
ability.label: Active Authority
ability.description: Twilight Colossus — Deals 420% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) True damage (ignores DEF and elemental resistance); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 125 SP · Cooldown 5 turns.
